posts.title: Welcome to BlogShammir
posts.content: This is a demo post for the BlogShammir theme developed by Md Shammir Ahmed. It showcases the beautiful typography and layout of the theme.

posts.title: Configuring Ads Control
posts.content: BlogShammir comes with a built-in Ads control mechanism via Customizer Advertisement Widgets. You can easily insert ads before header, after header, before/after post content, etc.
